claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.planeOverride
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family and charge-cast spell grant can represent the cube's charges, dawn recharge, and Magic action activation, but there is no honest way to express that pressing a given cube face constrains the granted Gate or Plane Shift cast to the plane keyed to that face.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.planeOverride
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The same missing shape is required for the second spell mode: the destination plane is not freely chosen at cast time, but inherited from the selected cube face.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side."
